== English errata comparison sources ==
The Dark Side Limited and Revised faces use Asteroid Cave, Will attack, and your choice. The 2013 Dark Side PC slip and the 2023 Appendix A use Cave, Attacks, and opponent of victim chooses. The 2013 sheet labels the slip with a bullet. The complete checked faces carry the independent symbol. The printed Ferocity * and Hide 3 agree across the faces.
